Class LobbyUpdateDTO

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.dto.LobbyUpdateDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
DTO
public class LobbyUpdateDTO extends Object implements DTO
DTO carrying a lobby progress update: the current lobby state, the game id, an optional game-state snapshot (for rejoin) and the player counts.
